zh: 站在门口的戈会哈随即一面掀帘，一面向外高唱：“送客等胡雪岩一走，刘秉璋回到签押房，随即将一本由吏部分发到浙江的候补知县的名册取了出来，细细检阅，这本名册除了姓名、年龄、籍贯、出身、到省年月以外，另有两项记载，一项是曾派何差，如某年月派案某、某年月派解”京饷“之类，再一项便是此人的关系，是刘秉璋亲笔所注，如某中堂表亲、某年月日某尚书函托等等。刘秉璋现在要派二十九员候补知县的差使，根据四个条件来考虑。
en: The orderly at the doorway immediately raised the curtain and called out, “See the guest out!” Once Hu Xueyan had gone, Liu Bingzhang returned to his private office and took out the register of expectant county magistrates whom the Ministry of Personnel had assigned to Zhejiang. He examined it carefully. Besides each man’s name, age, native place, qualifications, and date of arrival in the province, the register contained two further kinds of information. One recorded previous assignments: an investigation undertaken in such-and-such a month and year, for instance, or the escorting of revenue silver to the capital. The other recorded his connections, in Liu’s own hand: a cousin of a certain grand secretary, or recommended by a particular minister in a letter of a certain date. Liu now had assignments for twenty-nine expectant magistrates and would make his choices according to four criteria.

zh: 第一个条件是出身，正途优先，假使是“榜下即用”的新科进士，一时无缺可补，甚至连署理都没有机会，当然毫不考虑地先派这个差使。一翻名册，这种情形只有三个人，当时在名册上一勾，还剩下二十六个人要派。两榜出身的进士以外，举人当然比军功保举及捐班来得占便宜，但须看第二个条件，即是其人的关系，如果曾有朝中大老的“八行”推毅，当然是在候选之列，但还要看第三个条件，最近派过差使没有？派的差使是苦是美？最近派过苦差使，为了“调剂”起见，不妨加以考虑，否则就要缓一缓了。费了好大的功夫，才将一张名单拟妥，即时派戈什哈个别通知，翌日上午到巡抚衙门等候传见。同时另抄一张全单，送交德馨作参考。
en: The first was qualifications, with priority going to men who had entered through the regular examination route. A newly successful jinshi designated for immediate appointment, but still unable to obtain a vacancy or even an acting post, would naturally receive one of these assignments without further consideration. Liu found only three such men in the register and marked their names, leaving twenty-six places to fill. After the jinshi, who had passed both the provincial and metropolitan examinations, provincial graduates naturally enjoyed an advantage over men recommended for military merit or admitted by purchase. But this depended on the second criterion: their connections. A letter of recommendation from a senior figure at court would certainly place a man among the candidates, though the third criterion still had to be considered. Had he received an assignment recently, and had it been onerous or lucrative? A man recently given an onerous task might be considered in the interests of balancing things out; otherwise, he would have to wait. It took considerable effort to complete the list. Liu then sent orderlies to notify the men individually that they were to await an audience at the governor’s office the next morning. A copy of the full list went to Dexin for his reference.

zh: 接到通知的二十九名候补州县官不敢怠慢，第二夭一大早，都备好了“手本”，齐集在抚院官厅待命。这天逢“衙参”之期，刘秉璋接见藩、桌二司及盐道、巡道、首府、首县——杭州知府及钱塘知县，一直到午牌时分，才轮到道班候补州县官进见，在座的还有德馨。知县见巡抚照例是有座位的，但人数太多，没有那么多椅子，值堂的差役去端了几张长条凳来，二十九位“大老爷”，挨挨挤挤地坐了下来，却还有两个人无处容身，一个赌气，退到廊下去听消息，一个做官善于巴结，看刘秉璋因为他还没有安顿好，不便开口，觉得让“宪台”久候，不好意思，便蹲了下来，臀部临空，双手按膝，仿佛已经落座似地。“今邀各位老哥来，有个差使要请各位分头去办。”刘秉璋说：“各位想必都已经从《申报》上看到了，胡观察的阜康银号倒闭，市面大受影响。阜康的存款之中，官款很多，不能没有着落。胡观察自愿拿他所开设的二十九家当铺，请我查封，备抵官款。现在就要请各位老哥，每人查封一家。“
en: The twenty-nine expectant department and county magistrates dared not neglect the summons. Early the next morning, with their formal visiting slips ready, they assembled in the waiting hall at the governor’s office. It happened to be a day for the regular official audience. Liu received the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, the salt and inspection circuit intendants, and the prefect and county magistrate of the provincial capital—the prefect of Hangzhou and the magistrate of Qiantang. It was noon before the expectant magistrates were admitted, with Dexin also present. County magistrates were ordinarily offered seats when they saw the governor, but there were too many men and too few chairs. The attendants brought in several long benches, and the twenty-nine “Your Honours” squeezed together. Even so, two men could find no room. One withdrew sulkily to the corridor to hear what happened; the other, more practised in ingratiating himself with his superiors, noticed that Liu was waiting for him to settle before beginning. Embarrassed to keep His Excellency waiting, he squatted down with his hands on his knees and his backside unsupported, as though he too were seated. “I have invited you gentlemen here because there is an assignment I wish each of you to undertake,” Liu said. “You have presumably read in the Shenbao that Circuit Intendant Hu’s Fukang Bank has failed, seriously disturbing the markets. Its deposits include a great deal of public money, which must be secured. Intendant Hu has voluntarily offered the twenty-nine pawnshops he owns for me to take into official custody as security for those funds. I now ask each of you to take charge of one.”

zh: 此言一出，无不诧异，却不敢发问，只有刚才虚蹲着的那人，因为双腿得无法忍受，正好装作发言，站起来舒舒筋骨。“回大人的话，这种差使，从来没有人当过，卑职不知道怎么样个当法？”“喔，”刘秉璋看了他一眼间道：“老哥贵姓？”“卑职姓马。“他叫马逢时，陕西人，刚至省不久。”德馨在一旁悄悄提示。刘秉璋点点头说：“马大哥的话不错，这种差使，我也是头一回遇到，不过，人不是生而知之的。各位莫非没有想到过，将来退归林下，也许会设典当谋生？收典当跟开典当是一样的，不外验资、查帐而已。”“再要请示。”马逢时又问：“验资、查帐以后，是不是封门。”“不是，不是。验资、查帐，如果毫无弊病，责成黄当管事，照旧经营。各位只要取具管事甘结，承认该典有多少资本，就可以交差了。“原来名为查封，其实是查而不封。接下来便由德馨主持抽签，马逢时抽到的，恰好是作为总号的公济典。
en: Everyone was surprised, but no one dared ask a question. Only the man suspended in his squat, whose legs had become unbearably painful, seized the chance to rise and stretch them under cover of speaking. “Your Excellency, no one has ever undertaken an assignment of this kind. I do not know how it is to be carried out.” “Oh?” Liu looked at him. “What is your surname, sir?” “Ma, Your Excellency.” “His name is Ma Fengshi, from Shaanxi. He arrived in the province only recently,” Dexin prompted quietly. Liu nodded. “Mr Ma is right. This is my first encounter with such an assignment too. But people are not born knowing everything. Have none of you considered that, when you eventually retire, you might open a pawnshop to support yourselves? Taking over a pawnshop is much the same as opening one. It amounts to verifying the capital and examining the accounts.” “May I ask further,” Ma said, “whether we are to seal the premises after verifying the capital and accounts?” “No, no. If the capital and accounts are found to be in order, hold the manager responsible for continuing the business as before. You need only obtain his written undertaking acknowledging the amount of capital held by the establishment, and your assignment will be complete.” So, though it was called sequestration, the premises were to be inspected rather than closed. Dexin then supervised the drawing of lots. Ma happened to draw Gongji Pawnshop, the principal establishment.

zh: 其时已在午后未未申初，当天查封，时间已不许可。马逢时领了公事回头，一个人坐着发愣，心里在想典当里又是帐目，又是“ 当头”，帐目则是那笔龙飞凤舞之字，比张旭、怀素的草书还要难识，“当头”则包罗万象，无所不有，自己一个人赤手空拳，如何盘查封存？而况公济典既然是总号，规模一定很大，倘或照顾不过来，查封之际出现了虚冒走漏等等情事，责任非轻。转念到此，愁眉不展，马太太不免困惑，一早兴冲冲上院，说有差使，看起来今年这个年是可以过得去了。不道一回来是这等神气，岂不可怪？
en: It was already about three in the afternoon, too late to carry out the inspection that day. Ma returned home with his official papers and sat alone, staring into space. A pawnshop meant both accounts and pledged articles. The accounts would be written in a flying scrawl harder to decipher than the cursive calligraphy of Zhang Xu or Huaisu; the pledges could include anything under the sun. How was he to inspect and secure it all single-handed, with no assistance? Gongji, being the principal shop, must be a large concern. If he failed to keep an eye on everything and fraudulent claims or concealed removals occurred during the takeover, his responsibility would be serious. His worried expression puzzled his wife. He had set off for the governor’s office so eagerly that morning, saying he had an assignment. It had looked as though they would be able to get through the New Year after all. Why had he returned in such a state?

zh: 这一来，少不得动问缘由，马逢时叹口气说：“派了个从来没有千过的差使，去查封胡财神的公济典。光是查帐验资，典当仍旧照常开门。你想，我连算盘都不会打，这个差使怎么顶得下来。”“马太太的想法不同，”到浙江来候补，只派过一个解饷的差使，靠当当过日子，朝奉的脸真难看。“她兴高彩烈他说：”想不到你会派这个差使，让我也出口气。“马逢时破颜一笑，“真正妇人之见。他说：”这个差使好处‘没有，倒霉有份。““怎么会倒霉？”“查帐，验资！如果我们动了手脚，将来责任都在我头上，吃不了，兜着走呢！”“我不懂你说的什么？”马太太想了一下说：“你何不去请教请教杨大哥？”
en: She had to ask. Ma sighed. “They have given me a task I have never done before: taking the God of Wealth Hu’s Gongji Pawnshop into official custody. I am only to examine the accounts and verify the capital; the shop is to remain open. Think of it—I cannot even use an abacus. How am I to manage?” His wife saw it differently. “Since we came to Zhejiang to wait for an appointment, you have had only that one assignment escorting revenue silver. We have lived by pawning things, and those pawnbrokers have given us such sour looks!” she said delightedly. “Who would have thought you would get this assignment? Now I can get a little of my own back.” Ma broke into a smile. “A woman’s view, indeed! This task offers no benefit, only a chance of trouble.” “How could it bring trouble?” “Examining accounts and verifying capital! If there has been any tampering, the responsibility will fall on my head. I shall have to bear all the consequences.” “I do not understand what you mean.” She thought for a moment. “Why not ask Brother Yang’s advice?”

zh: 这倒提醒了马逢时。原来这“杨大哥”是仁和县礼房的书办，住得不远，马逢时夫妇为人都很随和，并不看轻他的身分，平时“杨大哥、杨大哥”叫得很亲热。杨书办受宠若惊，也很照应马逢时，每年学台院试发榜，是他最忙的时候，有些土财主家的子弟中了秀才，请客开贺，总希望来几位有功名的贵客，壮壮门面，于是杨书办就会来通知马逢时，穿上官服，去当贺客，酒足饭饱，主人家还有一个红包，最少也有二两银子。一年象这样的机会总有七、八次，在马逢时也算受惠不浅了。因此，听了马太太的话，愁颜一展，唤他的儿子去请“杨伯伯”。杨书办这夭正好没有应酬，一请就到，动问何事。“我有个差使，不知道怎么办？还是内人有主意，说要请教杨大哥。“喔，马大老爷，”杨书办倒是按规矩来称呼：“是啥差使？”“查封当铺。”杨书办一愣，旋即笑道：“恭喜，恭喜！马大老爷，你好过个肥年了。”
en: This reminded Ma of a possibility. “Brother Yang” was a clerk in the rites section of the Renhe county office and lived nearby. Ma and his wife were easygoing people who did not look down on his position, always addressing him warmly as Brother Yang. Flattered by their kindness, the clerk did what he could for Ma. His busiest time came each year when the education commissioner posted the results of the qualifying examination. When the sons of wealthy country families won their first degree, their families gave celebratory banquets and hoped to attract a few distinguished guests with examination honours to lend the occasion prestige. Clerk Yang would notify Ma, who put on his official robes and attended. Besides being well fed and supplied with wine, he received a red envelope from the host containing at least two taels. There were usually seven or eight such opportunities a year, so Ma owed Yang a good deal. At his wife’s suggestion his face brightened, and he sent his son to invite “Uncle Yang.” The clerk happened to have no engagement that day and came at once, asking what was the matter. “I have an assignment I do not know how to carry out. My wife had the good sense to suggest asking your advice, Brother Yang.” “Oh, Your Honour”—Yang observed the proper form of address—“what sort of assignment?” “Taking a pawnshop into official custody.” Yang was startled, then smiled. “Congratulations! Congratulations! Your Honour, you will have a fat New Year.”

zh: 此言一出，马逢时的表情，顿时不同，又惊又喜地问：“杨大哥，你这话怎么说？”“我先请问，是不是查封胡大先生的当铺？”“是阿！”“哪一家？”“公济。”“嘿！那马大老爷，你这个年过得越发肥了。”马逢时心里越喜，但也越困感，搔搔头问：“我，我是看得到，吃不下。”“这话怎么说？”杨书办立即又是省悟的神情，“喔，马大老爷，你是说，不晓得怎么样下手，是不是？”“不错。”马逢时紧接着说：“要肥大家肥。杨大哥，你是诸葛亮，我是刘先生。”“不敢，不敢！等我想想，有个朋友，一定帮得上忙。”“杨大哥，你这位令友，今天找得找不到？你要知道，明天一早就要动手。”杨书办想起一个朋友，便是周少棠。从他的阜康门前“登台说法”，为胡雪岩解围以后，名气大为响亮，马逢时也知道有这样一个人，很乐意向他请教，但怕时间上来不及，因为查纣一事，次日上午便须见诸行动。“不要紧，不要紧！”杨书办看一看天色说：“这时候去正好，他在大井巷口隆和酒店吃酒。”大井巷在城隍山脚下，有口极大的甜水井，井的对面，就是隆和酒店，周少棠每天傍晚在那里喝酒，即令有饭局，也一定先到隆和打个照面，所以这时候去了，即令他不在，也会知道他的行踪。
en: Ma’s expression changed at once. Surprised and delighted, he asked, “Brother Yang, what do you mean?” “First let me ask: is it one of Mr Hu’s pawnshops?” “Yes.” “Which one?” “Gongji.” “Ha! Then your New Year will be fatter still.” Ma grew happier and more puzzled. Scratching his head, he said, “I can see the food, but I cannot get it into my mouth.” “What do you mean?” Understanding immediately dawned on Yang’s face. “Ah, Your Honour, you mean you do not know how to begin?” “Exactly.” Ma added at once, “If there is to be any fat, let us all share it. Brother Yang, you are Zhuge Liang, and I am Master Liu.” “You flatter me! Let me think. There is a friend who could certainly help.” “Can this friend of yours be found today? You see, I have to begin first thing tomorrow.” The friend Yang had in mind was Zhou Shaotang. Since his performance outside Fukang had relieved Hu’s predicament, Zhou’s reputation had grown considerably. Ma had heard of him and was very willing to seek his advice; he was only afraid there would not be time, since the takeover had to begin the following morning. “Do not worry.” Yang looked at the sky. “This is just the right time. He will be drinking at Longhe Tavern, by the entrance to Dajing Lane.” Dajing Lane lay at the foot of City God Hill and contained a very large well with sweet water. Longhe Tavern stood opposite it. Zhou went there for a drink every evening; even when invited to dinner elsewhere, he always put in an appearance first. If they went now, they could find out where he was even if he had already left.

zh: 当下安步当车，走到隆和，其实华灯初上，隆和正在上市。吃“柜台酒”的贩夫走卒，各倚着柜台，人各一碗，悠闲自在，其中识得杨书办的人很不少，纷纷招呼。杨书办一面答应，一面往里走——里面是一座敞厅，摆了十几张方桌，已上了七成座，杨书办站定看了一下，没有发现周少棠，便拉一个伙计问讯。“周先生来过走了。不过，停一停还要来。”伙计问道：“你老是等他，还是留话？”“我等他好了。”于是挑了一张位在僻处的桌子，两人坐了下来，要了酒慢慢喝着，喝到第三碗酒，周少棠来了。“少棠，少棠！”杨书办起身叫唤，将他拉了过来说道：“我们等你好半天了。我先来引见，这位是马大老爷，”周少棠是很外场的人，对马逢时很客气地敷衍了一阵。等酒到微酣，杨书办方始道明来意，马逢时随即举杯相敬：“我对当铺一窃不通，接了这个差使，不知道该怎么办？”他说：“全要仰仗周先生指点。”“好说，好说。”周少棠一面应答，一面在肚子里做功夫。他跟公济典的唐子韶，只是点头之交，但阜康的谢云青，却跟他很熟，最近的过从更密，从谢云青口中，知道了紧邻公济典的好些秘密，这当然也就是唐子韶的秘密。
en: They walked leisurely to Longhe. The lamps had just been lit, and business was getting under way. Hawkers and labourers drinking at the counter leaned there at their ease, each with a bowl. Many knew Clerk Yang and greeted him. Answering as he went, Yang made his way inside to an open hall containing more than a dozen square tables, about seven-tenths of them occupied. He stopped to look, saw no sign of Zhou, and caught a waiter to ask. “Mr Zhou has been and gone, but he will be back shortly. Would you like to wait or leave a message?” “I shall wait.” They chose a table in a quiet corner, ordered wine, and drank slowly. Zhou arrived as they were on their third bowl. “Shaotang! Shaotang!” Yang rose and drew him over. “We have been waiting ages. Let me introduce you. This is Magistrate Ma.” Zhou was adept in company and spent some time exchanging courtesies with Ma. Only when the wine had put them pleasantly at ease did Yang explain why they had come. Ma immediately raised his bowl in a toast. “I know nothing whatever about pawnshops. Now I have accepted this assignment, I have no idea how to carry it out. I must rely entirely on your guidance, Mr Zhou.” “You are very kind,” Zhou replied, while working things out in his mind. He and Gongji’s Tang Zishao were merely nodding acquaintances, but he knew Xie Yunqing of Fukang well and had seen a great deal more of him lately. From Xie he had learned quite a few secrets about neighbouring Gongji—and those, of course, were Tang’s secrets too.

zh: 周少棠很看不起唐子韶，同时因为与胡雪岩是贫贱之交，情分不同，所以对唐子韶在胡雪岩遭遇这样沉重的打击，不想想平日所受的提携，拿出良心来共患难，反而乘人于危，趁火打劫，在公济典中大动手脚，暗中侵吞，大为不平。如今恰有这样一个马逢时可以去查帐的机会，岂可错过。“马大老爷，人家都说我周少棠好说大话，做起事来不扎实。所以，查封公济典这件事，我不想多说啥，只有一句话奉告，马大老爷把我这句话想通摸透，包你差使办得漂亮。”周少棠停了一下说：“这句话叫做：”看帐不如看库，验资不如验货‘。“马逢时一愣，因为周少棠的两句话开场白颇为突兀，有点发牢骚的意味在内，因而嗫嚅着说：“周先生我们今天是初会，我从没有说过那些话……”“啊，啊，误会了误会了。马大老爷，我不是说你，也不是说杨大哥，不过因为今天正好有人这样子说我，顺便一提。”周少棠又说：“马大老爷，你不是要我指点？我刚才那两句话，就是把‘总筋’指点给你看，你要看清楚，想透彻。”原来刚才那种近乎牢骚的话，是周少棠为引起交谈对方注意的一种方式，经此折冲，马逢时已将“看帐不如看库，验资不如看货”十二个字深印入脑中，当即作出受教的神色说道：“周先生，你这两句话，从字面上说，就大有学问在里头，索性请你明明白白地开导一番。”
en: Zhou had a very low opinion of Tang. His own friendship with Hu dated from their days of poverty, which gave it a particular depth. Now that Hu had suffered such a heavy blow, Tang ought to have remembered all the help he had received and shown enough conscience to stand by him. Instead, he was taking advantage of Hu’s distress, manipulating Gongji’s affairs and secretly embezzling its funds. Zhou bitterly resented it. Here was an opportunity to have Ma examine the accounts; how could he let it pass? “Your Honour, people say I talk big and never do anything properly. So I shall not say much about taking Gongji into custody. I have just one piece of advice. Understand it thoroughly, and I guarantee you will carry out the assignment splendidly.” He paused. “It is this: ‘Better to inspect the storeroom than read the books; better to examine the goods than verify the capital.’” Ma was taken aback. Zhou’s opening had been abrupt and sounded rather like a complaint. “Mr Zhou,” he stammered, “this is our first meeting. I have never said anything of the kind...” “Ah, a misunderstanding! I did not mean you, Your Honour, or Brother Yang. Someone happened to say that about me today, so I mentioned it in passing.” Zhou continued, “Did you not ask for guidance? Those two phrases point out the central thread. You must see it clearly and think it through.” His almost aggrieved opening had merely been a device to seize the other man’s attention. After this exchange, those twelve Chinese characters were firmly imprinted on Ma’s mind. Looking duly receptive, he said, “Mr Zhou, even on the surface those words contain a great deal of learning. Please go further and explain them plainly.”

zh: “言重，言重。”周少棠问道：“马大老爷，典当的规矩，你懂不懂？”“我刚才不说过，一窃不通。”“那就难怪了……”“老周，”杨书办忍不住了，“你不必城头大出丧，大兜大转了。马大老爷明天去查封，要留意哪几件事，请你细说一说。”“是的。”马逢时接口，“还有，一去要怎样下手？”周少棠心想，查封胡雪岩的典当，是为了备抵存在阜康的公款，能多保全一分，胡雪岩的责任即轻一分，因此，能将唐子韶在公济典侵吞的款子追出来，对胡雪岩就是最直接、也最切实的帮忙。转念到此，他决定插手干预。于是他问：“马大老爷去查封公济典，有没有委札？”“有。不过交代是抚台交代，委札是藩台所出。”“那一样，都是宪台。”周少棠又问：“领了封条没有？”“领了”“几帐？”“两张。”“怎么只领两张呢？”“我以为查封是封前后门，所以只领了两张。”马逢时又说：“后来想想不对，抚台交代，查封归查封，当铺还是照常取赎。既然如此，纣了门，岂非当主不能上门了。”“不独当主不能上门，公济的人也不能进出了。”周少棠想了一下说：“不过不要紧，马大老爷今天就去刻一个长条戳，上面的字是：”奉宪谕查封公济典委员候补知县马，。凭这个长条戳，马大老爷自己就可以封。“
en: “You are too kind,” Zhou said. “Do you understand pawnshop practices, Your Honour?” “Did I not say I knew nothing about them?” “Then it is no wonder...” “Old Zhou,” Yang interrupted impatiently, “stop leading us on a grand funeral procession round the city walls. His Honour has to take charge tomorrow. Tell him plainly what to watch for.” “Yes,” Ma added. “And how should I begin when I arrive?” Zhou reflected that Hu’s pawnshops were being taken into custody to secure the public money deposited with Fukang. Every additional sum preserved would reduce Hu’s liability. Recovering what Tang had embezzled from Gongji would therefore be the most direct and practical help he could offer Hu. He decided to intervene. “Have you an official warrant for this assignment?” “Yes. The instructions came from the governor, but the warrant was issued by the treasurer.” “That makes no difference. Both are your superiors. Have you collected any sealing strips?” “Yes.” “How many?” “Two.” “Why only two?” “I thought taking the premises into custody meant sealing the front and back doors, so I took only two. Afterwards I realised that could not be right. The governor said the shop was to continue allowing customers to redeem their pledges. If I sealed the doors, how could they come in?” “Nor could Gongji’s own people get in or out.” Zhou thought for a moment. “But that does not matter. Have an oblong stamp cut today, bearing the words: ‘By order of His Excellency: Commissioner Ma, Expectant County Magistrate, appointed to take Gongji Pawnshop into official custody.’ With that stamp, you can apply seals yourself.”

zh: “嗯，嗯，”马逢时一面想一面点头：“我应该有这人权柄。”“当然有。”“周先生，，‘马逢时问道：”明天我去了，第一步做什么？第二步做什么？请你给我说一说。““这，这要看情形，现在很难说。”说着，周少棠望一望杨书办。一直很冷静在旁听的杨书办，知道该他说话了：“马大老爷，我看你要请少棠去帮忙。”“是啊，是啊！”马逢时一叠连声他说：“我就有这样一个打算，不过不知道合不合公事上的规矩？”“怎么会不合？譬如马大老爷你‘挂牌’放了实缺，起码要请刑名、钱谷两位师爷，现在请少常去帮忙，也是同样的道理。”“是，是！这个譬喻通极。”马逢时双手举起酒杯：“周先生，请你帮忙。不过，惭愧的是，现在还谈不到什么敬意，只有感激在心里。”于是商定几个步骤，其实也就是周少棠在发号司令，马逢时要做的是，连夜将长条戳刻好，第二天一早在开市以前，便须到达公济典，首行要贴出一张告示：“奉宪谕查封，暂停营业一天。”然后分头查村，最要紧的是库房跟银柜。“这就要看帐了。‘看帐不如看库，验资不如验货’，此话怎讲？因为帐是呆的，帐面上看不出啥。到库房看过，再拿帐来对照，真假弊病就一目了然了。”
en: “Yes, yes.” Ma nodded thoughtfully. “I ought to have that authority.” “Of course you do.” “Mr Zhou, what should I do first tomorrow, and what should I do next? Please tell me.” “Well, that depends on what we find. It is difficult to say now.” Zhou glanced at Yang. The clerk, who had been listening calmly, knew his turn had come. “Your Honour, I think you should ask Shaotang to help you.” “Yes, indeed!” Ma answered eagerly. “I had just that in mind, but I did not know whether it would conform to official practice.” “Why should it not? If you received a substantive appointment and opened your own office, you would engage at least two secretaries, one for legal affairs and one for revenue. Asking Shaotang to help now is the same sort of thing.” “Quite so! An excellent comparison.” Ma raised his bowl with both hands. “Mr Zhou, please help me. I am ashamed to say I cannot yet offer any token of appreciation—only my heartfelt gratitude.” They then agreed on several steps, though in fact Zhou was issuing the instructions. Ma was to have the oblong stamp cut that night and reach Gongji before business began the next morning. His first action would be to post a notice: “Taken into official custody by order of His Excellency. Business suspended for one day.” They would then divide up the inspection, concentrating above all on the storeroom and the silver chest. “Then we shall examine the books. Why did I say it was better to inspect the storeroom than read the books, and to examine the goods than verify the capital? Because the books are lifeless things; you cannot see much from the figures alone. Inspect the storeroom first, then compare it with the accounts, and truth, falsehood, and malpractice will be clear at a glance.”

zh: “是，是。请教周先生，这姓唐的有哪些弊病？”马逢时间。“我也是听说，到底如何，要明天去看了才晓得。”周少棠说：“第一种是满当的货色上动脑筋，当本轻、东西好，这也有两种脑筋好动，一种是掉包，譬如大毛的皮统子，换成二毛的，还有一种……”“慢慢，周先生，请问这个弊病要怎么查？”“容易。一种是看帐，不过当铺里的帐，总是好的写成坏的，所以不如估价。”周少棠说：“朝奉的本事就在看货估价，决不会走眼，大毛是大毛的价钱，二毛是二毛的价钱，你拿同样的货色来比较，问它同样的当价，为啥一个大老，一个是二毛？他话说不清楚，里头就有弊病了。”“我懂了。请问还有一种呢？”“还有一种说是赎走了，其实是他占了满当的便宜。要查封这种弊病也不难，叫他拿销号的原票出来看，有，是真的赎走了，没有，就是当主根本没有来赎。”
en: “Yes, yes. What sort of malpractice has this Tang been guilty of, Mr Zhou?” Ma asked. “I have only heard reports. We shall not know exactly until we go tomorrow. The first kind concerns pledges whose redemption period has expired. If the loan is small and the article valuable, there are two tricks he can play. One is substitution: replacing a heavy fur lining with one of lighter fur, for example. The other...” “A moment, Mr Zhou. How do we detect that first trick?” “Easily. One way is to read the accounts, but pawnshop books always describe good things as poor ones, so valuation is better. A pawnbroker’s skill lies in judging and valuing goods; he will not get it wrong. Heavy fur commands one price and lighter fur another. Compare similar articles and ask why, if the loan amounts are the same, one pledge is heavy fur and the other light. If he cannot explain it, something is wrong.” “I understand. And the other trick?” “He says the pledge has been redeemed, when in fact he has appropriated the valuable article after its term expired. That is not difficult to detect either. Ask him to produce the original pawn ticket cancelled on redemption. If he has it, the pledge was genuinely redeemed. If not, the customer never came to redeem it at all.”

zh: 处理满当货的弊端，马逢时大致已经了解，但是否还有其他毛病呢？问到这一点，周少棠的答复是肯定的，而且词色之间，颇为愤慨。“这个姓唐的，真是狗彘不如！今日之下，他居然要趁火打劫，真正丧尽天良。”原来唐子韶从早康出事以后，认为胡雪岩之垮只是迟早间事，公济典当然也保不住了，既然如此，且趁眼前还能为所欲为之时正捞一笔。“他的手法很毒，不过说穿了一个钱不值，弄个破铜表来算是金表，一当十两、八两银子，马大老爷，你说，这是不是放抢？”“太可恶了！”马逢时亦是义形于色，“在满当货上动手脚，还可以说是取巧，因为东家的本息到底已经收回了，只不过没有占到额外的好处而已。象这样子，以假作真，以贱为贵，诈欺东家，是可以重办他的罪的。““当然应该重办。”周少棠冷笑一声：“他自以为聪明，假货要到满当没有人来赎，盘库日验货，才会发现，那时他已回徽州老家了，你就告他，他也可以赖，说当初原是金表，不晓得怎么掉包了。也没有想到，偏偏会遇到你马大爷，又遇到我，不等满当，就要办它一个水落石出，这叫‘人有千算，天只一算’。“
en: Ma now had a general understanding of the abuses involved in handling expired pledges. But were there others? Zhou’s answer was emphatically yes, and his voice and expression showed considerable indignation. “This Tang is worse than a beast! To plunder his employer at a time like this—he has no conscience left.” Since Fukang’s troubles began, Tang had believed Hu’s collapse only a matter of time. Gongji could not survive it either. He might as well seize what he could while he was still free to do as he pleased. “His method is vicious, though once explained it is worth nothing. He brings in a broken brass watch, treats it as a gold one, and advances eight or ten taels on it. Your Honour, is that not outright robbery?” “Abominable!” Ma too looked righteously indignant. “Tampering with expired pledges might at least be called sharp practice: after all, the proprietor has recovered his principal and interest and merely loses an additional profit. But passing off false goods as genuine and cheap goods as valuable to defraud the proprietor is an offence that can be severely punished.” “And severely punished it should be.” Zhou gave a cold laugh. “He thinks himself clever. The fake goods would not be discovered until the pledges expired without being redeemed and the storeroom was checked. By then he would be back home in Huizhou. Even if you prosecuted him, he could deny it: the watch had originally been gold, and he had no idea how it had been switched. He never expected to run into you and me, Your Honour. Before the pledges expire, we shall get to the bottom of it. As the saying goes, ‘A man may make a thousand calculations; Heaven needs only one.’”

zh: 谈到这里杨书办插嘴了，“唐子韶总还有同党吧？”他说，“朝奉是很爱惜名誉的，如果有为唐子韶勾结、欺骗东家这个名声在外，以后就没有人敢请教他，只好改行了。”“老杨，你问得好。唐子韶自然有同党；不过这个同党，同他的关系不同，是他一手提拔起来的外甥。”“嗯，嗯！这就是了。唐子韶预备卷铺盖了，当然也要带了他一起走。”“一点不错。”周少棠转脸说道：“马大老爷，你明天去了，就要着落在唐子韶的外甥身上，追究真相。要格外留心最近的帐，拿当得多的几笔，对帐验货，如果货帐不符，再问是哪个经的手？第一步只要这样就可以了，”“你是说当时不要追究？”“对，当时不要追究，因为当时一问，唐子韶一定有番花言巧语，打草惊蛇，不是聪明的办法？”“那么，怎么是聪明的办法呢？”“把唐子韶的外甥带走，另外找个地方去间。那些小生后经不起吓，一吓什么都说出来了。”周少棠又说：“最好到县衙门里惜两名差役带了去，威风更足，事情也就更容易办了。”“是，是，这倒容易，仁和县的王大老爷，我很熟。”马逢时越听越有兴趣，很起劲地问：“问出来以后呢？”是不是再传唐子韶来问。“
en: Yang spoke up. “Tang must have an accomplice. Pawnbrokers value their reputations. If a man became known for conspiring with Tang to cheat his employer, no one would engage him again; he would have to change his trade.” “A good question, Old Yang. Tang certainly has an accomplice, but the relationship is a special one: his sister’s son, whom he has advanced entirely through his own efforts.” “Ah, that explains it. If Tang is preparing to pack up and leave, he will naturally take the nephew with him.” “Exactly.” Zhou turned to Ma. “Tomorrow you must get at the truth through Tang’s nephew. Pay particular attention to the recent entries. Select several of the largest advances and compare the pledged goods with the accounts. If the goods do not match the entries, ask who handled the transactions. That is all you need do at first.” “You mean I should not pursue the matter on the spot?” “Exactly. If you ask then, Tang will have some plausible story ready. Alerting him before you are prepared is hardly wise.” “What would be wise, then?” “Take his nephew away and question him elsewhere. These youngsters cannot stand a fright; frighten them and they tell you everything.” Zhou added, “Better still, borrow two runners from the county office and take them with you. You will look more imposing, and it will make the work easier.” “Yes, that is easy. I know Magistrate Wang of Renhe well.” The more Ma heard, the keener he became. “And after we have the answers? Do we summon Tang for questioning?”

zh: “用不着你去传他，他自己会到府上来求见。”“何以见得？”“这……”周少棠迟疑一下，说声：“我先同老杨说句话。”“他将杨书办拉到一边，悄悄问他跟马逢时的关系。杨书办据实以告，周少棠便另有话问了。“快过年了，马木老爷当然要弄几个过年盘缠是不是？”“当然。”杨书办问：“你的意思是要他敲唐子韶一笔？”“不错，不过，公私要兼顾，他可以同唐子韶提条件：条一，要他拿原当赎回去，这是公，第二，要弄几两银子过年，数目他自己同唐子韶去谈……或者，同你谈。如果唐子韶不就范，报上去请他吃官司。“杨书办盘算了一下，觉得其事可行，笑笑说道：“你对胡大先生倒是蛮够朋友。”“贫贱之交不可忘。”周少棠掉了句文，虽然有些不伦，却不能说他这句话不通。
en: “You will not need to summon him. He will come to your house and ask to see you.” “What makes you so sure?” “Well...” Zhou hesitated. “Let me have a word with Old Yang first.” Drawing the clerk aside, he quietly asked about his relationship with Ma. Yang told him truthfully, and Zhou asked another question. “The New Year is approaching. His Honour will naturally want to find a little money to see him through it?” “Of course. You mean he should squeeze something out of Tang?” “Exactly. But both public and private interests must be considered. He can give Tang two conditions. First, Tang must redeem the pledged articles himself: that protects the public interest. Second, he must provide a few taels for the New Year. His Honour can negotiate the amount with Tang—or you can. If Tang refuses, report him and let him face prosecution.” Yang considered it, decided the scheme was workable, and smiled. “You really are a good friend to Mr Hu.” “One must not forget the friends of one’s poverty,” Zhou replied, dropping into a literary phrase. The quotation was not altogether appropriate, but neither could one say it made no sense.

zh: 两人再深入地谈了一下，自然而然地出现了一种演变，即是襄助马逢时的工作，由周少棠移转到杨书办身上。不过周少棠仍在幕后支援，商定他在阜康钱庄对面的一家安利茶店喝茶，公济典近在咫尺，有事随时可以接头。等相偕回到原座，周少棠作了交代，“马大者爷，”他说：“你同杨书办很熟，明天请他陪了你去，有啥话说起来也方便。其中的窍门，我同杨书办说过了，这桩差使，一定可以办得漂亮。”说着起身告辞而去。其时已是万家灯火，酒客络绎而至，热闹非凡，说话轻了听不见，重了又怕泄漏机密，杨书办提议另外找个地方去喝酒。“到哪里？”“你跟我去，不过，”杨书办声明在行先，“马大老爷，到了那个地方，我不便用尊称，一叫马大者爷，露了相不好。”“不要紧，你叫我老马好了。”“最好连姓都不要用真的。你们老太太尊姓？”“姓李。”“我就叫你老李了。离这里不远，我们走了去。”
en: As they discussed the matter further, a change came about naturally: the task of assisting Ma passed from Zhou to Yang. Zhou would still support them from behind the scenes. They agreed that he would sit drinking tea at Anli Tea House, opposite Fukang Bank. Gongji was only a step away, so they could contact him whenever necessary. Returning to the table together, Zhou explained, “Your Honour, you and Clerk Yang know each other well. Ask him to accompany you tomorrow; it will be easier to discuss anything that arises. I have told him the essential points, and this assignment will certainly go well.” He then rose, said goodbye, and left. By now lights shone from every house, and drinkers were streaming into the tavern. It was extremely noisy. If they spoke softly they could not be heard; if loudly, they risked revealing their secrets. Yang suggested going elsewhere for another drink. “Where?” “Come with me. But I must say this first: when we get there, I cannot address you by your title. Calling you ‘Your Honour’ would give you away.” “Never mind. Call me Old Ma.” “Better not use your real surname either. What is your honoured mother’s surname?” “Li.” “Then I shall call you Old Li. It is not far. Let us walk.”
